_meta.purpose: FCC Part 15.247 generic 902-928 MHz harmonic suppression sanity check. Spurious limits: outside 15.205 restricted bands >= 20 dB (30 dB with the averaging power method) below the in-band 100 kHz peak (15.247(d)); inside restricted bands the 15.209(a) field-strength limits (e.g. 54 dBuV/m at 3 m above 960 MHz = -41.23 dBm EIRP). The rejection targets below are generic engineering targets, not regulatory values.
